content.title: Estimated amounts of radiation absorbed in procedures used to diagnose pulmonary embolism
content.description: Table of estimated foetal radiation exposure and estimated maternal radiation exposure to breast tissue for various diagnostic tests (values are approximate ranges). Based on various references (385, 392–398).
